user_requirement: Every source utterance and meaning must be represented at its original speech time; rewrite unsuitable wording instead of leaving empty gaps.
interpretation: Unused cue room is measured, but genuine source silences must be distinguished before judging all gaps artificial.
acceptance_gates: no unexplained missing narration during source speech
rewrite or regenerate mismatched lines; do not fill with silence
solution: cut each approved take at its measured silences and re-lay the spoken chunks on the original speech timeline; only silence moved
remaining_limitation: text density is ~79% of the source word count; raising it needs a re-record
